shared_elements: circular disc/roundel with radiating spokes or rays
concentric rings around a central boss
raised relief carving on a stone surface
justification: Both surfaces present a prominent circular disc with a central boss set within concentric rings, and both include horizontal bands of repeated small motifs; in A the disc is a small emblem on the chest of a large anthropomorphic figure, while in B it is a large spoked wheel of a vehicle occupying nearly the whole field. The dominant content differs entirely — A shows a monolithic standing human/figural form with headdress, face, arms and body ornaments, whereas B shows an architectural/vehicular relief scene with harness, textile pattern and a petal border, with no figure visible — and the rendering conventions (blocky, deeply schematic volumes vs. flat low-relief linear detailing) are unrelated.
